title: WOW - What an amazing tour!!!  Bravo to Sofia!
text:
My husband and I had an amazing tour experience with Sofia.  She was very helpful from the very beginning; communicating with us before we arrived, providing information on getting tickets, and even tips and information regarding Seville. 

During the tour, she was an excellent storyteller while guiding us through the critical parts of the Alcazar and Cathedral.  Sofia did a fantastic job taking our photos throughout the tour.  We had such a wonderful time; I highly recommend that you book Sofia as early as you can because her dates book up quickly.
author: Clownfish88

title: A wonderful morning tour.
text:
If you are visiting Seville, a private tour with Sofia Ventura is an absolute must. Sofia has a wonderful, engaging personality and a clear passion for her city's history. It truly felt like exploring these stunning historical sites with a knowledgeable local friend.

title: Exceptional Private Tour of Seville’s Cathedral & Royal Alcázar
text:
We had an absolutely wonderful experience with our private guide for the Seville Cathedral and Royal Alcázar. Our guide was knowledgeable, personable, and did an incredible job bringing the history of these beautiful places to life.

We learned so much about the history, architecture, and the people who shaped Seville, but the tour never felt like a dry history lesson. Our guide was engaging, patient, and happy to answer all of our questions. They also made sure we were comfortable throughout the tour, which was especially appreciated given the heat.

title: Sofia is the best!
text:
First of all Sofia is a lovely person.
Her grasp of English is impeccable also.
Very knowledgeable and she is very proud of her Sevillian heritage. 
The cathedral and Alcazar are stunning.
She was so sweet she even bought us a gift!
Who does that? I have been to so many tours and she was the first that has done that.
Thank you for a wonderful time spent.
I wholeheartedly would recommend Sofia for this tour, you will not be dissatisfied.
Muchos Gracias Sofia ❤️

title: Excellent day with Sofia
text: We had a great day with Sofia.   The moment we booked months ago she sent me a text and clearly explained how to purchase the necessary tickets.    She was very informative but laid back.    My family agreed she was our favorite tour guide of our entire trip!
